pages.title: Ring Of Pocketbox
pages.text: With this ring you own a world of your own. Use it in the Overworld and you step into your pocket box: a meadow of 32 by 32 blocks in a quiet valley with trees and a pond, under the same sun and moon as the Overworld. No monsters ever spawn there, and every player gets a box of their own that nobody else can see. You can build up to 32 blocks high. Walk too close to the edge or the ceiling and a shimmering border appears. Fall through the floor and the box catches you again. Use the ring once more to return to the exact spot you left. Entering costs 50 Somnium, leaving is free.

pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: Embark on a journey of magic and creation with this special artifact! To craft it, you'll need to harness the power of the Arcane, a mysterious and ancient force that holds the secrets of the universe. With it, you'll be able to bring this artifact to life and unleash its full magical potential. So why wait? Gather your materials and begin crafting this mystical object today!
